task_instruction: Implement the arena bot sensor targeting setup from the tutorial. In `res://data/units/unit_stats.gd`, define `TARGET = { Team.PLAYER: "red_bots", Team.ENEMY: "blue_bots" }` so units can look up the opposing group name from their team. Create `res://custom_nodes/detect_range.gd` as `class_name DetectRange` extending `Area2D` with exported `col_shape: CollisionShape2D`, `base_range_size: float`, and `stats: UnitStats`; when `stats` is assigned, set `collision_layer` to `4 * (stats.team + 1)`, set `collision_mask` to `2 - stats.team`, and replace the collision shape with a `CircleShape2D` whose radius is `base_range_size * stats.attack_range`. Create `res://custom_nodes/target_finder.gd` as `class_name TargetFinder` extending `Node` with an exported `actor: BattleUnit`, a `target: BattleUnit`, a `targets_in_range: Array[BattleUnit]`, and a `targets_in_range_changed` signal. On ready, connect the actor's `DetectRange.area_entered` and `area_exited` signals to handlers that append or erase only `BattleUnit` instances and emit `targets_in_range_changed`. Implement `find_target()` so it uses `UnitStats.TARGET`, `get_nodes_in_group()`, and `distance_squared_to()` to store the closest opposing `BattleUnit` in `target`, and implement `has_target_in_range()` to return whether `targets_in_range` is non-empty. In `res://scenes/battle_unit/battle_unit.tscn`, add a `DetectRange` Area2D child with a `CollisionShape2D` child and a sibling `TargetFinder` node, wire both to the battle unit, and in `res://scenes/battle_unit/battle_unit.gd` expose them as `detect_range` and `target_finder` onready variables while assigning `detect_range.stats = stats` when battle-unit stats are set.
solver_diff:
--- original/custom_nodes/detect_range.gd
+++ solver/custom_nodes/detect_range.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+class_name DetectRange
+extends Area2D
+
+@export var col_shape: CollisionShape2D
+@export var base_range_size: float
+
+var stats: UnitStats: set = _set_stats
+
+
+func _set_stats(value: UnitStats) -> void:
+	stats = value
+	if not value or not is_node_ready():
+		return
+
+	collision_layer = 4 * (stats.team + 1)
+	collision_mask = 2 - stats.team
+
+	var circle = CircleShape2D.new()
+	circle.radius = base_range_size * stats.attack_range
+	col_shape.shape = circle
--- original/custom_nodes/target_finder.gd
+++ solver/custom_nodes/target_finder.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,53 @@
+class_name TargetFinder
+extends Node
+
+@export var actor: BattleUnit
+
+var target: BattleUnit
+var targets_in_range: Array[BattleUnit] = []
+
+signal targets_in_range_changed
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	if not actor:
+		return
+
+	actor.detect_range.area_entered.connect(_on_area_entered)
+	actor.detect_range.area_exited.connect(_on_area_exited)
+
+
+func _on_area_entered(area: Area2D) -> void:
+	if area is BattleUnit:
+		targets_in_range.append(area)
+		targets_in_range_changed.emit()
+
+
+func _on_area_exited(area: Area2D) -> void:
+	if area is BattleUnit:
+		targets_in_range.erase(area)
+		targets_in_range_changed.emit()
+
+
+func find_target() -> void:
+	target = null
+	var group_name = UnitStats.TARGET.get(actor.stats.team, "")
+	if group_name.is_empty():
+		return
+
+	var candidates = get_tree().get_nodes_in_group(group_name)
+	var closest_dist := INF
+	var closest_unit: BattleUnit = null
+
+	for candidate in candidates:
+		if candidate is BattleUnit and candidate != actor:
+			var dist = actor.global_position.distance_squared_to(candidate.global_position)
+			if dist < closest_dist:
+				closest_dist = dist
+				closest_unit = candidate
+
+	target = closest_unit
+
+
+func has_target_in_range() -> bool:
+	return not targets_in_range.is_empty()
